description: Brentwood, TN – State Senator Shane Reeves (R-SD14) today endorsed Marsha Blackburn for Governor. In a video, Senator Reeves said: “I am honored to have the opportunity to be standing here with my friend, Senator Marsha Blackburn, and to officially say I’m endorsing her to be the next governor of the great state of Tennessee.
